messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Multiple GPU OOMs detected on prod-cluster-12 during prefill phase (high long-context load). Several service containers restarted in the last 3m. Auto-throttle triggered. Paging oncall.

maria_oncall: on it. seeing spike in prefill token length distribution, lots of 80k+ context requests. linking grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/CLUSTER12/prefill-ooms

kevin_sre: logs show repeated 'CUDA out of memory' followed by container restarts on node gpu-12-3. Kernel messages: `E/launcher: killed process 2345 (OOM)`. Looks like prefill allocation + KV cache exceeded available GPU mem.

maria_oncall: mitigation idea: enable cold-model fallback and cap prefill window to 32k for this cluster. Can we push a routing rule to fallback to cpu-backed small-model for >32k?

sasha_runtime: I can flip fallback policy. Command: `redwoodctl route update --cluster prod-cluster-12 --policy "prefill_length<=32000->serve, else->coldmodel"` doing dry-run then apply.

incidents-bot: ACTION LOGGED: maria_oncall assigned, kevin_sre assisting. Paging: pagerduty notified.

kevin_sre: Also scaling down concurrent prefill batch size from 16 to 6 to reduce simultaneous peak allocs. Applying via k8s patch:

kubectl -n inference patch deployment runtime --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"PREFILL_BATCH_SIZE","value":"6"}]}]}}}}'

maria_oncall: applied routing change and batch size. Monitoring memory pressure and restart rate. Metrics show restart rate dropping but one node still noisy (gpu-12-3). Marking node for cordon/drain.

kevin_sre: cordoning gpu-12-3 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-12-3` then `kubectl drain gpu-12-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to move remaining pods.

daniel_eng: heads-up: customer-reported errors from large-context beta users. Emma, can you triage customer impact?

emma-cs: yes, getting tickets showing 503s for embeddings/generation when users send very large prompts. Escalating to enterprise CSMs. Sending initial customer note: "We're investigating intermittent errors linked to long-context requests; short-term mitigation applied to reduce impact. Will follow up with RCA."

maria_oncall: current status: fallback + batch cap live, node cordoned, restart rate down 85%. No broader latency regression. Oncall hold for 30m to watch for regressions.

sasha_runtime: adding temporary extra eviction for KV cache on prefill to cut peak allocs: pushed hotfix to runtime v1.23.4-hotprefill.

kevin_sre: capturing crash dumps and nvml stats for the noisy node. Saved /var/log/nvidia/gpu-12-3.dump to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/6681239999/ . Will attach to postmortem.

maria_oncall: escalation/handoff plan: I'm taking the initial incident owner. If this persists past 23:40 UTC I'll hand to second-shift oncall @kevin_sre. Action items: (1) postmortem runbook, (2) confirm fallback rule stays until root cause addressed, (3) test better prefill memory accounting in staging.

kevin_sre: noted. If anything spikes again, enable temporary capacity on cluster-13 as overflow: `redwoodctl capacity add --cluster prod-cluster-13 --pool extra-prefill --gpus 4`

emma-cs: customers notified of mitigations. No PII or data exposure. Will follow up with affected accounts with timeline.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, partial service recovery observed. Owner: maria_oncall. Severity lowered to sev-2 pending monitoring.

maria_oncall: handoff complete for now. Leaving this thread open for final confirmation and postmortem assignment. Thanks all :thumbsup:
